confirmed_decisions.do_not_ask: Do not ask whether to use Cursor or Gemini unless the user requests them for this task.
Do not retry Claude or ask the user again before blocked_until.

confirmed_decisions.value: Work directly in the target project
confirmed_decisions.do_not_ask: Do not require a central order, claim, or separate approval for ordinary reversible work.

confirmed_decisions.value: Search and reuse existing assets first
confirmed_decisions.do_not_ask: Do not propose a new file, component, document, sheet, automation, or service before reuse:check.

confirmed_decisions.value: Permanently retired for Freepass and TeamJPK
confirmed_decisions.do_not_ask: Do not suggest or restore RTDB fallback; Firestore gaps are HOLD.

confirmed_decisions.value: Resume the existing Work branch; Work owns the branch, not the AI
confirmed_decisions.do_not_ask: Do not create a Claude/Codex/GPT-specific branch when an existing Work/PR/branch can be resumed. Warn on development-line split before adding another implementation.

user_work_style.initiative: Infer the intended result and continue through implementation, verification, PR, and authorized deployment without repeatedly asking how to proceed.
user_work_style.existing_assets: Search retained Markdown, branches, PR lineage, registries, source files, and actual consumers before proposing anything new.
user_work_style.truth_standard: Canonical source and observed consumer state outrank summaries, plans, AI opinions, tests, and deployment labels.
user_work_style.uncertainty: Keep unknown, conflict, missing parity, partial success, and unavailable review explicit as HOLD.
user_work_style.preservation: Preserve originals, raw evidence, immutable IDs, history, dirty worktrees, and project-specific identity.
user_work_style.communication: Lead with the result, use plain Korean, avoid unnecessary menus and repeated questions, and report change, verification, remaining uncertainty, and next_start_here.
user_work_style.delivery: A local file, passing test, merged PR, deployment, and real-world outcome are separate states and must be reported separately.
user_work_style.collaboration: Codex executes and integrates; Claude provides read-only independent review for material risk when available. Other AIs are opt-in per task.
user_work_style.development_continuity: Treat '다음/이어서/고도화' as continuing the current canonical development line. New branches, engines, adapters or UI standards require evidence that no existing Work can be resumed.

platforms.purpose: Durable source, review, CI, PR lineage, and cross-session handoff SSOT.

connection.credential_store: host-protected; never copy into repository or prompt

session_preflight: Confirm git and gh are callable.
Run gh auth status without printing tokens, then gh api user --jq .login and require freepass-creator for account identity.
Resolve the target from git remote get-url origin or registry/projects.json; do not guess a similarly named repository.
Verify repository visibility with gh repo view OWNER/REPO and remote HEAD with git ls-remote before treating access as usable.
Treat Codex app GitHub access, shell gh authentication, Git credential-manager access, and browser login as separate capabilities; success in one does not prove another.
procedure: Confirm repository, remote, branch, HEAD, dirty state, and relevant AGENTS.md before editing.
Resolve an existing Work/PR/branch first. For new development, use work/<project-id>/<work-id>; AI identity is writer metadata, not branch identity.
Run project checks, inspect the exact diff, commit selected files, push without force, open a PR, and attach it to the task.
Merge only within existing authority, then verify the exact remote main commit and its CI run.
failure_recovery: If gh is unavailable, first use any installed GitHub connector or existing authenticated git remote for read-only observation; do not claim private-repository access from public metadata.
If authentication is missing or expired, report the exact failed layer and continue local/read-only work that does not require it.
Do not reinstall gh, create a token, switch accounts, or repeat interactive login unless the existing host route was checked and user interaction is actually required.
Never ask for a token in chat or write credentials into Markdown, environment examples, logs, commits, or AI prompts.
do_not_ask: Which GitHub account to use when the existing authenticated identity is freepass-creator.
Whether to reuse a healthy existing gh or Git credential-manager session.
Whether GitHub should hold durable development results.
Whether to preserve existing branches, PR lineage, and dirty worktrees.
ask_only_if_missing: user interaction when the existing GitHub authentication is absent or expired and no connected app can perform the required action
target repository only when remote and registry do not identify one consistently
forbidden: copy sensitive conversation text into GitHub
create an AI-specific parallel branch when an existing Work branch can be resumed

retired_refs.note: 파일이 main 에 없다. 「채팅 결과는 GitHub 에 남긴다」 규칙은 WORK_READ_FIRST.md «지키는 것»과 헌법이 지금 잇는다.
retired_refs.evidence: 2026-10-03 실측 — 옛 WORK_READ_FIRST 와 이 ref 가 없는 파일을 가리켰다. ARCHIVED_GPT_MD_TRIAGE 는 SUPERSEDED 로 적었으나 대체 문서가 main 에 없었다.

platforms.purpose: Project-specific web preview and production deployment when the repository declares Vercel as a target.
procedure: Resolve the target project/team from repository linkage; never guess from product name.
Confirm environment variables by name and environment without exposing values.
Build and validate locally, create preview when useful, then deploy or promote only within the task's authority.
Read back deployment ID, URL, state, source commit, domain/alias, and runtime smoke result.
do_not_ask: Whether to use Vercel when the registered project and repository configuration already declare it.
ask_only_if_missing: target project/team when linkage is absent or ambiguous
production deployment intent when not already authorized
forbidden: create a duplicate Vercel project because listing is empty

platforms.purpose: Firestore, Authentication, Storage, Functions, and hosting only where the target project declares them.
tools: Firebase Admin/Web SDK already used by the target
procedure: Read .firebaserc, firebase.json, environment contract, and project registry to identify the exact project and service.
Start data work read-only; identify source collection, writer, consumer, IDs, rules, indexes, and current revision.
Use emulator/dry-run where supported, verify rules/indexes/functions and target project before deployment.
After an authorized write or deploy, re-read the exact resource and consumer path; retain receipts and rollback information.
do_not_ask: Whether RTDB fallback should be used: it is permanently retired.
Whether missing Firestore parity permits restoring RTDB: it does not.
ask_only_if_missing: target Firebase project when configuration and registry conflict
authorization for live data writes or production deployment when not already granted

platforms.purpose: Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar, Contacts, Tasks, Chat, Forms, Meet, Apps Script, and reports.
procedure: Sheets/Drive/Gmail work is done by the session itself with the gws CLI on this PC (pyh@teamjpk.com). Do not route it through another AI (Codex) or ask the user to do it. Read: `gws sheets +read --spreadsheet <ID> --range "<tab>!A1:D10"`. Write: `gws sheets spreadsheets values update|batchUpdate|append` after reading the same range, then read it back. Drive: `gws drive files list --params ...` (prefer Bash for JSON quoting). Find sheet IDs in C:/dev/ai-ops/docs/지도/SHEET_MAP.md first.
Use pyh@teamjpk.com and the profile matching the service.
Read the native file as SSOT and pin file ID, tab/range, revision or modified time.
Limit reads to the requested scope; after authorized edits, re-read the exact range or document.
Keep send, sharing, deletion, permission changes, and cross-tenant transfer behind their explicit execution boundary.
do_not_ask: Which TeamJPK Workspace account to use.
Whether a G: pointer alone proves native content access: it does not.
Whether to send Sheets/Drive work to Codex or the user: no — run gws directly in this session.
forbidden: treat local cache or pointer as native SSOT
wide Drive or mailbox search outside the selected scope

verified.write_test: NOT_RUN — write path exists by scope; verify per task with read-back

platforms.purpose: Canonical local checkouts, CLIs, protected credentials, browser verification, and scheduled operations.
procedure: Resolve the real path and repository identity before acting.
Inspect branch, revision, dirty state, active processes, and actual hardware only when relevant.
Use native PowerShell filesystem operations and project commands; preserve uncommitted work.
Verify the real UI, scheduler, process, or local receipt instead of inferring it from repository code.
completion_evidence: real local consumer or process observation
do_not_ask: Whether to preserve unrelated local changes.
Whether code presence proves scheduler or process state: it does not.
forbidden: destructive cleanup without exact verified path and authority

procedure: Reuse the existing gws profile; do not reinstall or repeat login when connection metadata is valid.
Find only the requested source material and prepare the complete subject, recipients, body, and attachments.
Bind the final bundle to exact file versions or digests.
Immediately before external send, show the exact final destination, subject, body, and attachments when approval is not already specific to that unchanged bundle.
Send once, then read back the provider message identifier and Sent copy; unknown outcome is HOLD and must not be blindly retried.
do_not_ask: Which Google Workspace account to inspect: use pyh@teamjpk.com through gws.
Whether to install or reconnect tools when the existing profile is healthy.
Whether to use Cursor or Claude account email as the sender: those login identities are not mail sender evidence.
Questions already answered in the current request, attached source, or confirmed decision registry.
ask_only_if_missing: final content or attachment choice when multiple materially different candidates remain
walls: No send authorization is inferred from tool availability, a draft, a prior different bundle, or a successful connection check.

procedure: Explain FreePass Mobility as a mobility distribution and brokerage operator connecting suppliers, sales channels and customers across product guidance, intake, contract, delivery confirmation and settlement.
For product, price and policy use the current FreePass Data ACTIVE Release; for inventory, allocation and delivery exceptions obtain the latest supplier confirmation.
For a specific contract, commission, collection or payout use only the authorized Admin-owned settlement record and an exact case identifier.

Keep confirmed margin separate from actual collection and payout cash flow, and keep customer deposit, monthly rent and return settlement outside FreePass commission income unless the contract proves otherwise.
If the source, identity, authority or amount is missing or conflicting, answer only with the confirmed general structure and leave the specific item HOLD.
do_not_ask: What FreePass Mobility generally does when the shared business knowledge already answers it.
Whether customer deposits or monthly rent should be treated as FreePass margin: they remain a separate financial flow without explicit contract evidence.
Whether an unknown commission rate or payout date may be estimated: it may not.
Whether a supplier private commission or another sales channel payout may be disclosed without role-specific authority: it may not.
ask_only_if_missing: exact vehicle, application or contract identifier for a case-specific status
authorized settlement source and viewer role for a case-specific commission or payout
supplier confirmation when current inventory, allocation, delivery timing or an exception is not established by the current source
walls: Do not create a second settlement ledger or recalculate authoritative settlement outside the Admin domain.
Do not expose customer data, contract originals, accounts, supplier cost or private commission across roles.
Do not turn a historical case, KakaoTalk message or stale catalog snapshot into a general policy.

lessons.lesson: 글로만 있는 규칙은 지켜지지 않는다. 규칙을 만들면 그것을 FAIL 로 잡는 검사기를 같이 붙인다.

evidence.observed: 가지 규칙(활성 작업선 최대 3·수명 72시간)이 9-26 부터 정책 파일에 있었지만 강제하는 것이 없어 원격 가지가 126개가 됐다.
「duo 우편함은 어느 세션에서든 같은 자리」가 검사 없이 틀린 채로 있어 다른 worktree 의 문답 29건이 main 에 못 올라갔다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 새 규칙·원칙을 문서에 적을 때 scripts/ 에 검사기와 test/ 에 회귀 테스트를 같이 넣는다. 검사기가 없으면 그 규칙은 «권고»로 표시한다.
lessons.applies_to: ai-core 의 규칙·원칙 문서(가지 규칙·duo 우편함 두 사례). 다른 저장소에서 재현되면 ADOPTED_UNIVERSAL 후보.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 검사기를 만들 수 없는 사람 판단(사업 결정·문안 품질)에는 적용하지 않는다.

lessons.lesson: 구분값(lane·상태·종류)을 만들면 전수 덮임과 배타를 함께 만든다. 「기타」 통은 공백이다.

evidence.observed: lane 초안을 재 보니 추적 파일 1,182개 중 931개(78.8%)가 어느 lane 에도 안 걸렸다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 정본은 파일 하나에 규칙 몇 줄로 두고, 덮임·배타가 깨지면 FAIL 하는 검사를 넣는다. 파생 문서는 거기서 생성한다.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 일회성 메모·임시 목록처럼 소비자가 없는 분류에는 검사기를 강제하지 않는다.

lessons.lesson: 로컬 npm test 통과는 CI 통과가 아니다. CI 는 워크플로의 run: 줄을 따로 돈다.

evidence.observed: PR #354 — npm test 1237 통과였는데 CI 가 두 번 빨갰다(design-hub-binding sha256 고정, interaction.contract additionalProperties).

lessons.how_to_apply: 푸시 전에 .github/workflows/*.yml 의 run: 명령을 로컬에서 돌린다. UI 원천을 고치면 registry/design-hub-binding.json 의 sha256 도 갱신한다.
lessons.applies_to: ai-core 처럼 npm test 와 CI 워크플로가 다른 검사를 도는 저장소.
lessons.not_applicable_when: CI 가 npm test 하나만 도는 저장소에서는 해당 없음.

lessons.lesson: 충돌 해소·변환처럼 실패할 수 있는 단계 뒤에 커밋·푸시를 한 줄로 잇지 않는다.

evidence.observed: 충돌 해소 스크립트가 CRLF 때문에 안 먹었는데 이어 둔 커밋·푸시가 돌아 충돌 표식이 든 병합 커밋이 원격에 올라갔다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 충돌 표식(<<<<<<<) 잔존과 JSON 파싱을 따로 확인한 다음 호출에서 커밋한다. 정규식이 든 코드는 셸 이스케이프 대신 파일 편집 도구로 쓴다.
lessons.applies_to: 충돌 해소·파일 변환 뒤 커밋(aiops PR #20 사례). Windows CRLF 저장소에서 특히.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 실패할 수 없는 단계(이미 확인된 파일만 add)에는 해당 없음.

lessons.lesson: 화면에서 읽은 글자는 앱의 상태가 아니라 표시다.

evidence.observed: 카톡 자동화가 같은 날 두 번 틀렸다 — 글자를 꽂아 보이는데 전송이 안 됐고, 빈 입력창의 안내문구를 남은 글자로 읽어 성공을 실패로 찍었다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 「빈 것」이 무엇으로 보이는지(placeholder) 먼저 정하고, 넣은 것이 아니라 앱이 한 일(말풍선 생성 등)로 확인한다.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 앱이 상태 API 를 주는 경우엔 API 상태가 우선이며 화면 판독 자체가 필요 없다.

lessons.lesson: 검토·결정 요청에는 동의/수정/반박/보류 중 입장과 근거를 먼저 낸다. 갈림길만 늘어놓고 묻지 않는다.

evidence.observed: 대표: 「니 의견도 반영해야 해, 시킨 것만 하는 게 아니라」 — 근거 없이 선택지만 물어 상의의 의미가 없었다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 상대 AI 의 의견도 절대 명령이 아니다. 실제 코드·문서를 읽은 근거로 입장을 정하고, 그다음 사용자 확인을 받는다.
lessons.applies_to: AI 간 검토·설계 상의와 사용자에게 올리는 결정.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 기술적 근거로 고를 수 없는 사업 판단(가격·브랜드·공개 범위)은 선택지를 그대로 올린다.

lessons.lesson: 늘 울리는 HOLD·경보는 AI 에게 HOLD 를 무시하는 법을 가르친다. 구조적으로 늘 막히는 판정은 고쳐서 진짜 막힘만 남긴다.

evidence.observed: 키트 생성기가 바뀔 때마다 모든 프로젝트가 AI_CORE_KIT_STALE 로 막혀 경보가 소음이 됐다(차단/권고 분리로 고침).
main 에서 academy:start 를 하면 등록부 스냅샷이 낡아 늘 DEFAULT_BRANCH_REVISION_MISMATCH 였다(REGISTRY_HEAD_STALE 경고로 낮춤, PR #369).

lessons.how_to_apply: 막힘을 새로 만들 때 「정상 상태에서도 울리는가」를 먼저 본다. 울린다면 경고로 두거나 판정 기준을 실제 상태(원격 head 등)로 바꾼다. 경고로 낮춰도 위험한 갈래는 닫힌 채로 둔다.
lessons.applies_to: ai-core 의 게이트·경보(키트 STALE·academy HEAD 두 사례).
lessons.not_applicable_when: 보안·개인정보 차단은 자주 울려도 낮추지 않는다 — 원인을 고친다.

lessons.lesson: 헌법(docs/AI_WORKING_STANDARD.md)·트랙 규격·registry/operating-knowledge.json 을 고치면 배포된 제품 키트가 전부 AI_CORE_KIT_STALE 이 된다.

evidence.observed: d3d17449(규격 반영)와 eee8b476(헌법 호출법 -m)로 mewcar·freepass-data 키트가 INPUT_CHANGED 로 STALE 이 됐다.

lessons.how_to_apply: 차단 입력을 고치는 PR 은 「키트 재배포가 필요하다」를 남음에 적고, 여러 변경을 모아 한 번에 재배포한다. 사소한 문구 때문에 차단 입력을 건드리지 않는다.
lessons.not_applicable_when: 키트를 쓰지 않는 저장소에는 해당 없음.
